title: Bounded coded-machine reachability
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, a mode $m$, a Boolean list $y$, a natural-number bound $B$, labels $\ell,\ell'$, and vectors $v,v'\colon\{0,\ldots,20\}\to\mathbb N$, the relation holds exactly when the compiled machine for $N$ and $m$ can reach configuration $(\ell',v')$ from $(\ell,v)$ on input $y$, using the specified code oracle and the guard determined by $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
caveat: The supplied material does not define the compiled machine, guarded reachability relation, or code oracle, so the precise reachability convention cannot be made self-contained.
